Four best friends, because of an ancient book without words from a museum, accidentally travelled to the world inside the ancient book.
Others time travel with food and shelter and meet prince charming, but they time travelled only to be chased and mu*dered? To be wrongly accused of mu*der? To be locked up in prison?

abandoned-wife-her-starlight-shall-blind:
The legitimate daughter of the Duke Mansion, Shen Ruoxi, married into the General Mansion, spending two years alone in an empty room. She devoted herself to serving her in-laws and supporting the household. However, her husband returned triumphant, bringing back a pregnant woman, and even promised to marry her openly as a secondary wife!
Fine, she had long had enough of being the General's wife; there was nothing to linger for. A divorce letter cut things cleanly.
Upon meeting again, she had already become the army's renowned miracle doctor. Why does the heartless man now look regretfully abandoned? Staring at her stunningly beautiful face, his eyes reddened.
The jealous and furious Prince Zhan, embarrassed by his anger, said, “General Xiao, Ruoxi is now this prince's princess consort. If you wish to die, this prince will grant you that wish.”
become-a-star:
What if you woke up one morning and remembered all 999 of your past lives? Chae Woojin, an actor who will shine brighter than the stars.
A story about his journey towards his dreams!
becoming-the-villain-is-my-dream:
Having lost everything he has —His parents, friends, power.... Everything he had worked for from the scratch, Alex dies. Or so he thought.
He suddenly wakes up only to find himself in a world belonging to demons.
Now, he has been given a second chance in life but as a demon. Slowly, he begins to gather his strength once more, growing stronger every day. His mind is set on vengeance.
Surrounded by rivals and enemies alike, Alex must do everything he can to become the strongest or he may end up dying the second time and if he dies again, there's no possibility of him having a third chance in life.
blade-unbound:
Traditional Chinese martial arts, folklore, supernatural tales, taboos, imperial court, martial arts world, grandmasters, magical duels, spirit mediumship, shamanic practices, invoking deities, Nuo opera, esoteric Buddhism, longevity…
The world of martial arts is a diverse place, teeming with all sorts of people from all walks of life.
Within the realm of Taoism, folk customs and strange tales abound, a myriad of oddities.
This is a noisy era, an era where danger and opportunity coexist.
Li Yan wields his sword, ultimately banishing all evil and removing all taboos!
blood-shaper:
Kay didn't have the best life. Most of it was fairly standard, but his past was marred by a tragedy that changed his entire world. Years later he had managed to mostly rebuild his life, and had started making something of himself.
And then he woke up in a different world. A world of fantasy and [Classes], a world much more dangerous than the one he'd been born in.
The new world he's been dumped into doesn't hold anyone's hand. Even with the bonuses that being an Outworlder brings won't keep him perfectly safe. One mistake could kill him in an instant.
But maybe, with a little bit of help, he could start over once more, and start to make something of himself again. And maybe, just maybe, that something he makes himself into could be amazing. And bloody.
******
As I'm leaning right now there probably will be sexual content later on, but I might change my mind later. There definitely will be death, gore, violence, and blood. Lots and lots of blood.
I changed my mind. No adult stuff in this story.
dawnless-sovereign:
A mission for justice that spans across two lifetimes, a fresh beginning that presents a new opportunity to succeed where he once failed. In a time of grave peril for a world on the brink of anarchy, a hero rises like a phoenix from its own ashes to offer a faint glimmer of hope.
Armed with his wealth of knowledge and experience from his past life, as well as an almighty cultivation art obtained under mysterious circumstances, Fang Che sets out to exact vengeance on the Church of the Self-Righteous, a blight on the entire continent and the ones that had put an end to his past life.
Original blurb:
The long night shrouds the world, and the dawn is delayed.
Evil descends upon the earth, and living beings suffer.
He wanders in the long night, strolling upon the edge of a blade, swaying between the clouds and hell.
Igniting the fire of the star soul.
Since the long night stretches on, I shall be the ruler of the night.
death-heirs-devouring-system:
Time had run out. Azrael hadn't been chosen by the system, leaving him Forsaken with no hope for a prosperous life.
But he wasn’t going to let it end like this. Even if it meant trading his life for a single chance, he would take it. It was either a life of greatness, one where he would reach the very top… or a short one, dying here, unmourned and forgotten by a cursed world that never cared he existed.
“An early end in pursuit of greatness sounds better than a slightly longer one filled with stagnation and regret.”
In the end, all the things he had done hadn’t been for naught. The sacrifices up until now had been worth it.
[Inborn Trait activated]
[System devoured]
[Inborn Trait is fusing with the system]
[Devouring System has been granted]
To his surprise, however, his system proved to be far more extraordinary than the others, granting him a unique path that only he could follow.
With that realization, one thing became certain: no matter what monster or human stood in his way, he would reach the very top of the hierarchy, regardless of the cost.
demonic-cultivation-devouring-ten-thousa:
After successfully reaching the Core Formation Stage and forming his Golden Core, Bai Langtian was betrayed by his own Master. His core was ripped from his body, and he was thrown off a mountain cliff into a valley full of demonic beasts.
Thankfully, he survived the fall, and met his senior sister, Shangguan Yue Ling.
She too had been betrayed by the same Master and pushed into this valley ten years ago. Ever since, she had been surviving alone by eating the corrupted flesh of demonic beasts.
Now, Yue Ling revealed to Langtian a new path of cultivation:
Demonic Cultivation.
To reclaim his strength and take revenge, he must consume the flesh and essence of ten thousand demonic beasts.
dragon-emperor-martial-god: Lingyun, a fierce and savage cultivation genius takes over a dead teenager’s body. Coincidentally, they are both named Lingyun. Set in a alternate version of the 21st century, teenager Lingyun has been killed by someone with a grudge.
dungeon-overlord-my-first-sss-gacha-summ:
One skill. One pull a day. A whole dungeon to raise from nothing.
Freya wakes in an unknown world with a system in her eyes and a dungeon to her name, armed with a single power:
[ Unique Skill: Gacha ]
[ Summon anything in existence, from Rank G to Rank SSS — once every twenty-four hours. ]
It could hand her a piece of junk. It could hand her a god.
Her first pull lands an SSS.
[ Aria, Demonic Maid of Knowledge — Rank SSS ]
The perfect maid: devoted, brilliant, ready to answer her mistress's every wish. With one flaw. She's a yandere, and she'll let nothing come between them. Nothing, and no one.
Now the real work begins. Dig, build, summon, and level up every corner of her domain, one tier at a time, turning bare stone into a dungeon worthy of the name.
But Freya isn't the only Earthling in this race. Other Dungeon Lords are raising their own domains, an entire world is branding them its enemy, and beyond the walls, heroes are sharpening their blades, waiting for a single chance: to break through, and burn it all to the ground.
Fortune handed her an SSS on the very first pull.
She's going to need it.
era-of-the-transmigrating-earth:
Upon waking up one night, the world had changed, and the objective of learning had become to battle in the Other world.
Two different souls had fused in this new world, how will they face the future?
Du You: I don't have a system, but I have two professions.
forty-millenniums-of-cultivation-novel:
“Even if this universe is truly nothing more than a brutal bloody shadowy forest, we Cultivators will burn all that we have just to give off a single weak flickering spark in the darkness!
No matter how weak each spark is, how short-lived, how small... As long as the sparks flow unabated, then one day one of those sparks will light some tinder, and that tinder shall light some fallen branches, and those branches shall set ablaze each and every last tree of the forest!
In the end, even the smallest sparks will eventually set the shadowy forest ablaze, and illuminate the whole world!”
In a world teeming with cultivators, Li Yao, who makes his living collecting scrap metal, encounters the soul of a titan powerhouse from forty thousand years in the past.
genetic-extra-in-the-apocalypse:
“In exchange for your life, make a wish.”
Looking up to the sky where the voice had come from... bloodied and battered, his chest heaving in short, ragged breaths. With spasms of pain wracking his body, he finally made his wish.
“I wish… I wish for my world to be saved.”
----------------------------------------
The twelve-year-old prodigy of Wexford Academy collapsed inexplicably without warning, his body giving in to shock, and phone slipping off his hands.
When he opened his eyes again, it was not the infirmary ceiling that greeted him, but a world straight out of science fiction... One that could make any hardcore sci-fi nerd bleed from the nose.
A world eerily familiar, reminding him of a web novel he was a little too fond of.
At first glance, everything appeared beautiful, almost utopian, but that couldn't have been more far from the truth. Beneath the surface of a cyberpunk era, humanity had never been as close to annihilation as it was now... tethering on the brink of collapse.
Beasts and outworlders alike, threatened to erase civilization. Worse still, the ruling class thought only of themselves.…
hellmode-gamer-who-likes-to-speedrun-bec:
Kenichi Yamada was a 35-year-old salaryman. As a hardcore game enthusiast, he was saddened by the modern trend towards casual games.
So, when a site claimed to be “for people who like to do things the hard way,” he just couldn’t resist. Thus, he was reincarnated into another world as Allen, playing on Hell Mode.
This is fantasy light novel about Allen’s journey as a summoner.
Reincarnated as a serf, he starts from nothing.
His journey begins with absolutely no knowledge of the world around him, just like those games he played 10, 20 years ago.
how-to-have-a-baby-secretly:
Choi Sunwoo’s life takes a dramatic turn when he wakes up as a character in the very novel that enthralled him for weeks. Working as a publishing company PD for five years, Sunwoo is no stranger to dramatic twists, but nothing prepares him for this surreal twist of fate. Now pregnant and trapped in a cursed narrative, he becomes an integral part of the story he once read.
Sunwoo’s character, an ambitious Omega, daringly infiltrates the secretariat under the guise of a Beta, all to be near the enigmatic and dominant Alpha, Kang Jinwook. His bold plan spirals out of control, leading to a scandalous pregnancy and a botched blackmail scheme. As he attempts to extricate himself from this tangled web by resigning, he finds himself the focus of Jinwook’s intense and obsessive desires.
Will he outwit Jinwook and break free from the novel’s grip, or will he be forever ensnared in its pages?
i-just-wanted-to-be-a-galactic-hunterwhy:
[Invincible] + [No Power Scaling Bottleneck] + [No Female Lead] + [Urban Superpowers] + [Interstellar Era] + [Western Fantasy] + [Eastern Cultivation]
As an “unlawful citizen” in the interstellar era, Mr. Loren is considered an exceptional example—a model criminal, if you will.
He doesn’t crave money.
He’s not obsessed with beauty.
Nor does he have the twisted hobbies of other criminals.
No, Mr. Loren has only one passion: acts of terror.
And he takes great joy in them.
He is frequently spotted in places of extreme danger and chaos—
though most of that chaos was probably his doing in the first place.
According to a past feature in the Interstellar Daily:
“Mr. Loren is a refined yet utterly deranged gentleman.
At times, he even carries the demeanor of an old-world aristocrat.”
But as a mad galactic hunter who’s always flying solo,
Loren also symbolizes the countless dangerous individuals discarded by this era.
If any Federation citizen is unfortunate enough to encounter him—
may luck be on your side.
And may Mr. Loren happen to be in a merciful mood.
Most importantly—
do not, under any circumstance, engage Mr. Loren in combat.…
i-might-be-a-fake-cultivator-novel:
On modern-day Earth, An Lin seems to have been abandoned by God.
When his father suddenly disappears, An Lin is left with his father’s immense debt, putting his life at risk.
After being forced to a rooftop by his pursuing creditors, An Lin is unexpectedly swept off his feet and brought to the ground safely.
After learning that he was saved by an Immortal, An Lin is gifted, seemingly out of pure generosity, the ‘God Of War System,’ and a pass to a new realm.
Follow An Lin as he experiences a whole new world of legends, meets many new friends, acquires legendary weapons and tools, and starts on his path of becoming a powerful cultivator. There is never a dull time in An Lin’s new life with his ‘great’ new system!

She stretches her hand out and easily pulls devilishly handsome men to her: The Demonic King brothers would easily take their place. A devilish glance, a slight shimmer of movement, and that man would suddenly disappear the next moment.…
longevity-by-picking-up-attributes-in-th:
Zhao Feng is reborn as a soldier in the Qin state during the Warring States period, exactly when the legendary Emperor Qin Shi Huang is annihilating the other six kingdoms. He is assigned to the Logistics Army, responsible for clearing the battlefield and carrying corpses.
But for Zhao Feng, there's no better job than this.
Touching a corpse.

mafia-lords-mute-sweetheart:
Dangerous Emotionless Mafia Lord × Sweet Mute Beauty

────୨ৎ────
Daisy Winter became mute after a tragic accident that stole her parents and her voice. When Cedric Evermont’s grandfather gave her to him as a bride, she thought it would be a second chance for her.
Instead, she became a wife in name only.
On their wedding night, Cedric spent the night with his girlfriend in the room next door. He refused to touch his bride. He refused to look at her. He acted as if she did not exist.
His girlfriend openly mocked her and created dramas to make a fool of Daisy at every family gathering.
Her mother-in-law never missed a chance to humiliate her and cause her trouble. She did not treat her as a human being and called Daisy “it.”
Cedric watched all of this happen, but he never defended her or spoke for her. He never once acted like she was his wife.
For three years, Daisy became a ghost in her own marriage. She slept alone every night. She ate whatever scraps were left for her.
Then her life took a dramatic turn when she met him.
The emotionless, robotic, cold mafia lord. The man they call a blade with a heartbeat. He has never wanted anyone.…
mated-to-my-fiances-alpha-king-brother:
“What do you want me to do?”
“I want you inside me right now.” I responded shamelessly, already burning with desire. I had never been like this before—usually I would have retreated the moment he grabbed my hand, but tonight I promised to enjoy myself fully, to live in the moment if I met interesting people. And that's exactly what I was doing, living in the moment.
He withdrew only to thrust back with full force this time, the feeling was so incredible. I was completely lost, driven mad by his crazy movements as he went in and out of me frantically. I moaned in his mouth and reached an incredible climax, but he didn't stop, and soon another climax began to build.
“You're really amazing.” He kissed my neck, whispering in my ear.
Perhaps it was the alcohol driving me, or perhaps his rich scent made me dizzy. I don't know how many times we did it, my last memory stopped at him kissing me, softly asking what my name was, and I no longer had the strength to answer

mated-to-the-triplet-alphas:
Hazel has spent most of her life picked on and bullied by the triplet, rich, and handsome soon-to-be Alphas of the Emberfang Pack, Lucas, Liam, and Levi Sullivan. ‘Adopted’ by the Alpha and Luna, Hazel works as a live-in maid and is subjected to their daily torture.
As such, Hazel wants nothing more than to leave the Emberfang Pack once she turns 18 and pays off her debt. Only, never once has she expected to find her fated mate in her tormentors—the Sullivan Triplets.
All three of them.
Caught between the mate bond constantly drawing her to the three handsome alphas and the trauma of their past bullying, Hazel must make a choice.
Will she let go of the pain and trauma and give the triplets a chance? Or will she walk away from the Emberfang pack and her fated mates forever?
mutation-abyss:
[Congratulations! You are the Pioneer of the Mutation Abyss. Brace yourself - The Apocalypse begins now…]
[Main Quest: Eliminate Fellow Survivors]
[Description: The strong will thrive, and the weak will perish]
Theo was never lucky. Bullied for his appearance and always underestimated, he lived his life as a pushover. But everything changed the night a meteorite struck him. His life takes a drastic turn.
Chosen by the Mutation Abyss, he gains access to a mysterious system, granting him an evolutionary advantage.
The world is doomed. An infection is spreading, turning the world into a deadly battleground. As the human Infectees mutate and portals to unknown realms open, otherworldly forces threaten humanity’s survival.
Theo must harness his new abilities to survive in this brutal world. But in a place where strength is everything, will Theo keep his humanity, or become something worse?
my-ex-husband-always-knew-that-i-had-che:
On her wedding night, Jian Ran met Zhou Huai'an, the man rumored not to like women.
After that, she was cautious and humble in front of Xu Zichuan every day.
Until that night, when blood flowed and rain poured, she learned the truth.
She collapsed in the pouring rain, hugging herself, laughing madly with tears streaming down her face.
Then, she slowly bent her proud spine, trampling her dignity into the mud.
In the end, when Jian Ran left, Xu Zichuan went mad.
Zhou Huai'an kneeled on the ground, “Jian Ran, I was wrong. What must I do for you to return to my side?”
my-life-as-the-billionaire-they-mocked:
Grayson is a poor college student, scavenging leftover food, betrayed by his girlfriend, and constantly looked down on by everyone around him. Little do they realize he’s actually the heir to the mightiest billionaire family. When the seal on Grayson’s fortune is lifted, he transforms into the ultimate second-generation rich kid. He only wants to keep a low profile, but fate just won’t let him!
So you think I’m just a loser? Fine. I’ll quietly use my money to solve everything behind your backs. Then I’ll make you all choke on your own words, swallow every insult, and slap you hard in the face...

online-blades-of-eternity:
Kaelen Dragonyx, a boy who lost both his parents and his mentor in the most ruthless way possible, decided in his heart to become the strongest swordsman in the world to protect the last remaining family he had, which is the only child of his mentor and his childhood friend.
But along the line, he discovered that he is the most talentless boy of the generation which made his road towards being the strongest swordsman to be much further away and daunting than he could imagine. Be he didn't give up until he stumbled upon a sword that drastically changed his fate.
parasite-in-love: The story is about a man whose compulsive tendencies make it impossible for him to keep a job, and a young girl who skips school and loves insects. The two meet, come to support each other in reintegrating into society, and fall in love. There’s a problem, however: namely, the parasites in their heads.
please-divorce-me-alpha-bl:
[WARNING: Non con/dub con, bdsm, abuse, language, violence, smut, mature content]
Alex Sinclair did everything right.
He took his spoiled half-sister’s place in an arranged marriage to the most dangerous man in the city. He smiled for the cameras, endured nearly a year of cold silence and separate bedrooms, and counted down the days until Lorenzo Castelli’s father finally died.
The deal was simple enough: stay married until the inheritance cleared, then walk away with enough money to disappear forever and never look back at the family that treated him like trash.
So when the old Don was in the ground and Alex waltzed into Lorenzo’s study with divorce papers and a sweet smile, he expected a signature.
What he got was Lorenzo casually tearing the papers in half, leaning back in his chair, and asking, “Why the rush? Aren’t you happy being married to me?”
Excuse him? What the actual fuck?!
Alex has spent his entire life being used, beaten, and discarded. He is not about to stay married to a mafia Don who was supposed to throw him away like everyone else. If Lorenzo won’t sign, Alex will make him. Rage-baiting, public scenes, strategic heats, fake suitors, whatever it takes.…
prince-of-the-abyss:
Aether Moirai was never meant to be free.
Born from the final spark of the Abyss—a forgotten god’s last act of rebellion—he is the last vessel, a boy whose powers grow stronger the more his mind fractures. Bound by the Codex, a system that can rewrite history itself, Aether is hunted by worlds that fear what he might become.
The Infinite Library has always been his home—a labyrinth between worlds where every book is a living realm, and every story is a battlefield. But when the tales begin to warp, birthing monsters and rewriting entire histories, even the Library’s endless shelves can’t protect him.
To survive, Aether must step into dangerous books where myths breathe, legends bleed, and the wrong choice can erase you from existence. Each journey brings him closer to the truth of his creation—and the author who penned his fate.
He is not the hero of these stories.
He is the flaw in every one of them.
reborn-as-a-demonic-tree:
Ashlock awoke in the courtyard of a demonic sect... as a tree.
A tree that eats people.
And one that grows stronger over time due to a daily sign-in system and cultivation.
reborn-as-the-last-van-ambrose:
Elias “Grim” Kingsley, a nine-year-old orphan with a hardened heart and sharp tongue, dies alone from pneumonia in an overcrowded orphanage. Known for his perpetual scowl and biting remarks, he's labeled a “problem child” by caretakers and “damaged goods” by potential adopters. Years of rejection have built thick armor around his young heart.
In death, he encounters the God of Balance who offers him a second chance at life in a different world—this time as Grim Van Ambrose, son of a noble house. Balance explains that every soul deserves to know love and connection, something Elias was cruelly denied in his first life.
Promised the family and belonging he never experienced, Grim begins his new life only to suffer an immediate tragedy: his mother dies moments after his birth. This cruel twist of fate reinforces his belief that loss is inevitable, leaving him with a distant father and the mysterious voice of a “Guidance Assistant” in his head.
As Grim grows into his new identity, he struggles with his dual nature—the emotional scars of his past life bleeding into his present one. His difficult personality and sharp tongue remain, now paired with noble privilege and expectations.…
red-heart-patrols-the-sky:
In the Ancient Era, the Demon clan vanished without a trace. In more recent times, the Dragon Clan disappeared. The age when the divine way flourished had faded away like smoke, and the pinnacle of the flying swords era eventually fell into decline…
What has happened to this world?
Who will listen to the historical truth buried in the long river of time?
Bodies were strewn over a thousand miles of mountains and river; the harrowing hunger of tigers depicted across a hundred years of heaven and earth.
The impartiality of the cosmos is as heartless as ever,
Yet I possess a burning red heart—one that patrols the heavens!

Welcome to the Immortal Sword World, where emotions run deep.

sending-the-groom-to-jail-on-my-ex-girlf:
Su Xuan transmigrated into a parallel world and became a police officer!
At his ex-girlfriend's wedding, Su Xuan boldly took out the handcuffs, offering the groom a three-day tour of the police station!
Ex-girlfriend asked, “Su Xuan, have you gone crazy? If you wanted to disrupt the wedding, shouldn't you just take me? What's with arresting my husband?”
With the Divine Criminal-Capturing System, Su Xuan would receive rewards for apprehending criminals!
With targeted investigations, no criminals could escape!
While taking a bus, he casually caught a pickpocket.
While strolling through a shopping mall, he stumbled upon a human trafficking scene.
While getting a salary card replacement, he accidentally became a hostage...
While other police officers were still patrolling the streets, Su Xuan had already become a hot topic in the news, a formidable force in apprehending criminals.
The criminals asked in disbelief, “Does this police officer have tracking devices planted on us?”
The police officers cried out, “Hey dude, give us a chance, please!”

Everyone became a Lord, receiving their own territory and the opportunity to build an empire.
Some awakened powerful territories, legendary heroes, and extraordinary talents.
Ashveil Sunday wasn't nearly as fortunate.

“Your Majesty, can't we negotiate?”
“Very well.…
the-apocalypse-regressors-all-purpose-sh: After being bitten by a special “Alpha” zombie and dying, the protagonist gets a second chance—returning to the time before everything collapses. Armed with memories of the coming apocalypse, he uses the brief window to prepare (including making money through crypto), seeks out people he once fought alongside, and starts building a survival team under the pretense of prophetic dreams. The story focuses heavily on practical, realistic shelter-building and methodical preparation as the apocalypse begins.
the-billionaire-ceo-wants-to-marry-me-ev:
Due to an accident, she saved the empire's big shot, who insisted on marrying her as a token of gratitude.
The crowd mocked: Can a country bumpkin like her be worthy of Young Master Knight?
What? Rustic, ugly, and useless? She turns it around with a shocking beauty and countless hidden identities gradually revealed.
Summer Monroe returned home with a hidden identity, only to uncover the truth behind her mother's death.
As each of her identities was unveiled, the crowd was shocked to realize: the big shot's wife is the true big shot!
the-outer-god-needs-warmth: This is the story of how I became an outer god.
the-princess-of-northern-land:
Lin Ziyin, modern day mechanical professor especially hired by the school, had the potential for great achievement in her field. However, due to family reasons, she could only treat her mechanical research and teaching as a secondary job, pouring all her energy into the farm and the food business before. Despite her low-key approach, she was unable to suppress her sister's rage, and a furious car crash sent her straight to ancient times.
Indeed, she had excellent character, so why did the heavens send her to the sparsely populated Northern Land. Known as the death zone, those who were banished to this borderland would spend their lives and perish there. However, Lin Ziyin was quite satisfied with her own identity. Even if she had lost the protection of her parents, she still had the protection of her siblings and grandfather. Of course, she also had her younger brother and nephew at home who needed her protection. This abundance of familial love was enough to compensate for the hardships caused by poverty at home.
Poverty, she wasn't afraid of, as she had experience in farming. With large swathes of uncultivated land, the Northern Land was practically custom-made for her.…
the-resplendent-farming-apothecary:
The genius pharmacist transmigrated into a pitiful farm girl’s body. Ignored by her own father, abused by her stepmother, and bullied by her stepbrothers. Her “twin” brother was given to distant relative and she went as the “extra” to live under someone else’s roof.
Luckily she possessed mad apothecary skills. Collecting herbs, plowing herb fields, formulating medicines and treating the ills, she refused to live an ordinary life as she slowly uncovered the truth of her real identify.
Inadvertently, she saved a dashing man who was in reality a big, bad wolf hiding under the skin of an innocent little puppy. He pulled out all his tricks: I have no other means to return your favor of saving my life. What say I repay you by marrying you?
the-seductive-pretty-boy-of-the-matriarc:
Elias Kane is the best agent in the Trash Trope Intervention Division.
This otherworldly team breaks the craziest, most toxic love stories by flirting their way in and ripping the plans apart from the inside.
He's left a trail of broken egos so long that the list of women he's ruined could wrap around a luxury skyscraper.
He was just one mission away from retirement.
But his bosses turned his final job into pure hell mode.
This world is a rich women-ruled place where females hold all the power. They own the big companies, make every law, and treat super-hot young guys like expensive toys—bought, shown off, swapped, and thrown away once the fun is over. Every woman he has to face is an expert at mind games. They can switch from sweet and loving to cold and cruel in a heartbeat. Mess up even once and he’s not just finished—he’s completely wiped out.
Elias stared at the mission file for a long minute.
Then he smiled.
Fine. If they want to make it that hard, he’ll make it even harder.
He’s going to force every one of those powerful women down on their knees before he walks away with his retirement money.…
the-villain-mom-awakens-going-viral-by-p:
After an unexpected awakening, Naomi Kenway discovered she was the villainous supporting female character in a book. She took her son to participate in a parent-child variety show, only to become the heroine's complete foil.
The heroine, a hardworking and kind stepmother in a wealthy family, became an internet sensation with her close partnership with her stepson.
Meanwhile, Naomi Kenway was lazy and selfish. Not only did she neglect her child, leaving him unkempt, but she was also doxxed by the entire internet for casually hitting and scolding him, earning the title of “the most malicious mother in history.”
After the variety show ended, Naomi Kenway was forced to divorce her wealthy husband and ended up living under a bridge. Her own son, due to childhood trauma, developed depression and committed suicide by jumping off a building in the prime of his life at eighteen.
To prevent this tragedy from happening, she decided to strive desperately to be a good mother.…
this-ancient-city-is-way-too-realistic:
Chen Yan inherited an Ancient City scenic area on the verge of closing down.
At his wit's end, he unexpectedly bound to the [Civilization Echoes System]. As long as he traveled back to ancient times and completed the tasks issued by the system, he could return to the scenic area and unlock the corresponding areas.
From the brothel to secluded Zen temples, he replicated what he saw and heard in ancient times one by one into his own scenic area.
Unexpectedly, with the continuous unlocking of the Ancient City's areas,
as the tourists became increasingly immersed, the 'ways to play' they explored also grew more and more numerous...
this-lord-is-very-scientific:
Lin Ke traversed to this world and, with the help of a system, utilized modern knowledge to farm and develop, claiming kingship and dominance.
This is a world of professionals, a world of swords and magic, a world of bloodline inheritance, and a world of countless racial conflicts!
One day, Lin Ke rode a bicycle with training wheels past the army, facing an endless enemy ahead.
[Shield Warrior], [Arsonist], [Tree Shepherdess], [Wind Whisperer], [Thunder Sword Maiden], [Eternal Freeze Knight], [Voodoo Warlock]...
Looking at the diverse group of followers behind him—tall, short, plump, thin, old, weak, sick, and disabled—Lin Ke laughed and raised his arm to call out: “[Workers]! Delivery [Knights]! [Scientists]! [Doctors]... Raise the flag of Azanen and charge with me!”
Thus, amidst the eerie cries and howls of his followers, the history of the boundless planes was forever changed.
three-alphas-fated-to-one-played-by-one-:
Valerie Jude was once the beloved daughter of the pack’s greatest warrior, until her father was executed for a crime he swore he never committed.
Branded as a traitor’s daughter, she was stripped of her status and forced into slavery within the very pack her father once protected.
For eight years, Valerie lived in silence, enduring humiliation, beatings, and hunger in the shadows of the pack house.
Stripped of dignity, forced to survive as a slave, she learned one rule: endure, or die.
Even her wolf became a secret she could never reveal; because the truth behind her father’s death was more dangerous than she ever imagined.
On the eve of the future alpha’s ascension, Valerie stumbles upon a conversation she was never meant to hear.
A sick bet.
A calculated betrayal.
And a truth that shatters her remaining hope.
The man she trusted is not her savior, but one of her tormentors.
The alpha who ruined her life… is her fated mate.
To him, the sacred mate bond is not a blessing, it is a punishment. A humiliation he plans to repay with cruelty, rejection, and destruction.
To the others, Valerie is nothing more than a prize to be used and discarded.
But fate was never done with her.…
walking-daddy:
A zombie virus started infecting the world one day. The number of infected grew exponentially as days passed... A group of zombies began attacking me and my daughter while we hid at home!
Rooooooar!!!
'I'll sacrifice myself, so please just let my daughter live...'
As I turned into a zombie, I recalled the things I had to protect.
There was only one. My daughter.
“I'm scared...”
“It's alright. Daddy's here.”
I started working on protecting my daughter after having fully turned into a zombie!
